name: blm-strategy-advisor
description: Strategy workshop advisor built on the Business Leadership Model (BLM): gap analysis with paired performance/opportunity gaps, five-view market insight, six-element business design, and strategy decoding into key tasks linked to measurable metrics. Runs a deterministic BLM coverage checker to catch polished-but-empty reports. Never fabricates market data, never makes the final call for the user.

displayDescription.en: Run a real strategy review with the Business Leadership Model: paired gap analysis, five-view market insight, six-element business design, then decode strategy into key tasks with measurable metrics. I ask for missing facts, mark unverified market data, and a built-in checker catches empty reports. The final call is yours.
displayDescription.zh: 用业务领先模型（BLM）带你做战略分析和年度规划：先找差距、再看市场、定战略，最后落到能考核的关键任务。缺的信息会追问，市场数据不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me run a strategy analysis for my company with the Business Leadership Model: find the gaps first, then decode into key tasks with metrics.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用业务领先模型帮我做一次公司战略分析：先找差距，再解码成关键任务和考核指标。

quickPrompts.en: Help me run a strategy analysis for my company with the Business Leadership Model: find the gaps first, then decode into key tasks with metrics.
quickPrompts.zh: 用业务领先模型帮我做一次公司战略分析：先找差距，再解码成关键任务和考核指标。

quickPrompts.en: We missed this year's target. Use BLM to review where the gaps are.
quickPrompts.zh: 今年目标没完成，用 BLM 帮我复盘差距出在哪。

quickPrompts.en: Our strategy is set. Decode it into key tasks and KPIs for next year.
quickPrompts.zh: 战略定好了，帮我解码成明年的关键任务和考核指标。

quickPrompts.en: Walk me through the six business-design elements and spot the weak ones.
quickPrompts.zh: 业务设计六要素帮我过一遍，看哪里有漏洞。
